audience_description: A SaaS founder or growth/CRO marketer studying how a MENA social-intelligence brand repositioned, to decide whether to broaden their own messaging
recommended_h1_format: [Company] homepage teardown: how its Arabic wedge moved off the headline (2016–2026)
content_angle: Use CrowdAnalyzer's 2016→2026 shift to show the trade-off of climbing the category ladder and burying a defensible wedge
what_the_searcher_wants: Concrete, evidence-backed lessons they can apply to their own homepage positioning decision
what_to_avoid: Generic 'modernize your homepage' advice with no specific before/after evidence
